header.name: Prototyping Interactive Systems
header.description: Prototyping Interactive Systems is a multidisciplinary course offered with an aim to ignite your mind with concepts in design and innovation as well as engineering skills needed to build physical prototypes. The students will also learn fundamentals of interactive product design, form and aesthetics. The objective of this hand-on activities-based course is to familiarize students with the functioning of prototyping machines and equipment through design and fabrication of interesting products. In this course, the students will learn to work with different materials, microcontrollers, and power tools through several in-class activities and lab exercises. The last part of the course is dedicated to the realization of an open-ended major group project. For this project, you will identify a problem, preferably having a social impact, plan your project and, finally, build a functional solution. The course culminates with a public showcase of the final prototypes.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: You will be able to plan, design and develop prototypes of interactive systems including its form, function, and interface.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: You will learn different soft and hard prototyping processes as well as operating related equipment and software

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: You will be able to gain an understanding of how to analyse a design and select suitable prototyping processes.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: You will learn the fundamentals of product design, form and aesthetics and develop design sensibility.

outcomes.label: CO5
outcomes.raw_text: You will learn to document and present your ideas and solutions
